text:
Why is the heating coil of a domestic immersion heater placed at the bottom of the tank?
A
Cold water is less dense than hot water and therefore sinks.
B
Cold water is more dense than hot water and therefore rises.
C
Hot water is less dense than cold water and therefore rises.
D
Hot water is more dense than cold water and therefore sinks.

options.label: A
options.text: Cold water is less dense than hot water and therefore sinks.

options.label: B
options.text: Cold water is more dense than hot water and therefore rises.

options.label: C
options.text: Hot water is less dense than cold water and therefore rises.

options.label: D
options.text: Hot water is more dense than cold water and therefore sinks.
